character.name: Zero
character.portraitAlt: Zero, an athletic human with long auburn hair and a full beard, wearing a red-lensed scouter, black martial outfit and burgundy cape outside Capsule Corp. Character illustration.
character.origin: From a world where Dragon Ball is fiction. The cause of the crossing is still unknown.
character.appearance: Athletic build, long curly auburn hair, full auburn beard. Black wrap-front outfit and loose trousers, burgundy sash and wrist wraps, burgundy cape with round gold fasteners, black-and-burgundy boots. The recovered scouter has a red lens; the cape’s hem was torn during the arrival encounter.
character.personality: Expressed through your choices and dialogue.
character.backstory: Familiar with Dragon Ball through anime, manga, films and games before the crossing. No further personal background is recorded.
character.arrival: Woke outside Capsule Corp in West City with an unfamiliar athletic body and new clothes. Nappa’s attack left him critically injured. Vegeta intervened, arranged evacuation and later proved to be a Time Patroller. Zero gave his name before losing consciousness.
character.motivation: Train, become stronger and qualify for field work.
character.knowledge: Retains referential knowledge of Z, Super, the films, manga, GT and the first two Xenoverse main stories. Chronoa confirmed that the two Xenoverse stories correspond to this Patrol’s past, with distinct hero partners; the second occurred about two hub years ago. This particular Vegeta’s home history remains unknown.
character.limitations: Source knowledge does not grant fighting mastery or reveal alternate histories. Flight turns, braking and divided attention remain unreliable. Small ki blasts need a planted stance and deliberate charge. No field clearance or independent timeline access; the city escort restriction has not been lifted.
character.powerReading: After full healing · Day 45 · Confirmed twice
character.condition: Healed after the final senzu of today’s training. Clothes are bloodstained; scouter worn and cape collected. No weights equipped.

story.era: Time Patrol hub; local calendar date unconfirmed
story.date: Day 45 · Evening · Approximately 44 days since awakening
story.situation: After another day of gravity training with Vegeta, Zero has healed and measured 174. He has found Krillin finishing an ordinary practice session.
story.pendingChoice: Krillin notices the bloodstained clothes, asks whether Zero received a senzu, and welcomes him in: “I’m finished here. What’s up?” Zero has not answered yet.

abilities.title: Battle power · 174
abilities.summary: Current output confirmed twice after full healing at the end of Day 45.
abilities.details: Rested readings reached 60 on Day 8 and 64 on Day 10. Later checks recorded 67 on Day 13, exhausted 58 on Day 15, partially recovered 68 on Day 16, and pre-training readings of 75 on Day 22 and 84 on Day 29. Rested 85 was confirmed on Day 30 before Vegeta’s first session; after that day’s training and healing, two scans read 89. Continued training reached 124 at the end of Day 37 and 168 at the end of Day 44. Overnight rest confirmed the same 168 on Day 45; that day’s training increased it to 174, confirmed twice after the final senzu. Healing restores available output; it is not a separate human power boost. These readings do not establish field readiness.

abilities.title: Combat fundamentals
abilities.summary: Improving guard, turning and short combinations under gravity; still developing timing and balance.
abilities.details: Controlled sparring with Yamcha produced one successful shoulder throw using his committed shove, but Zero tired and the round ended. Weighted conditioning later reached 100 kg per wrist and ankle before those weights were returned. From Day 30, Vegeta’s sessions introduced 50× gravity. Zero can now complete controlled 25× warm-ups and stand, take measured steps and use short combinations at 50×. Quick turns and impacts still break his support. He has not landed a hit on Vegeta. No general mastery or dependable combat movement under that load is established.

abilities.title: Deliberate ki control
abilities.summary: Can gather, hold, extinguish and regather a small ki light during controlled steps and turns.
abilities.details: Developed from tiny flashes through weighted practice. A palm light has worked as a sparring distraction. Gravity training now requires active ki support to stand and move under load; hurried movement and impacts still disrupt that support. Precise sensing and suppression have not been demonstrated. This progress does not establish reliable flight or blast use at 50× gravity.

abilities.title: Flight
abilities.summary: Brief low hovering and slow flight over courtyard distances.

facts.label: Hover
facts.value: A few feet high, for several breaths

abilities.details: Low hovering and slow courtyard flight are established. Zero sometimes keeps airborne through glancing contact or recovers from a sideways shove, but solid body shots disrupt concentration. A faster unweighted crossing on Day 22 produced a wide turn, a drop and a slower return, ending upright. Braking, turning and divided attention remain unreliable. No fast long-range or dependable combat flight demonstrated. No new flight milestone was recorded during the gravity sessions.

abilities.title: Small ki blast
abilities.summary: Repeatable low-power shots from a planted stance after deliberate gathering.

facts.label: First success
facts.value: Day 22 · Shallow chip in a practice wall

abilities.details: The first shot succeeded once among several failed attempts. Practice through Day 29 made release repeatable, but shots still vary in aim and moving release is poor. No named beam, rapid barrage or destructive large-scale attack has been learned. Gravity training has not established accurate moving shots or firing at 50× gravity.

inventory.title: Black-and-burgundy outfit

facts.label: Pieces
facts.value: Wrap-front top, loose trousers, sash, wrist wraps and boots

inventory.details: Currently bloodstained from training, despite Zero’s injuries being healed. No protective rating, unusual material property or automatic clothing repair has been established.

inventory.title: Burgundy cape
inventory.summary: Gold-coloured round fasteners; torn near the hem.
inventory.details: Set aside with the scouter during Vegeta’s training and collected afterward. The hem remains torn; no repair or fresh fastening has been recorded.

inventory.title: Recovered red scouter
inventory.summary: Taken from Nappa before evacuation. Basic power scanning works.
inventory.details: Rill obtained the first reading of 50. Zero regularly checks his own output by targeting his outstretched arm while wearing it. Set aside for gravity training and retrieved afterward; currently worn. Two Day 45 scans after final healing read 174. Communications, maximum range and upper measurement capacity remain untested.

inventory.title: Room 214 access card
inventory.summary: Issued by Mr. Satan during the first evening’s room visit.
inventory.details: Opens the assigned room. It does not grant independent timeline travel or cancel the escort restriction.

accounts.title: Patrol support
accounts.summary: Assigned accommodation and dining-hall meals are covered.
accounts.details: Housing and meals are Patrol provision, not cash income. No wage or personal balance has been established. Borrowed weights are facility equipment and the latest set was returned after Day 29. Vegeta supplied senzu for training recoveries: two on Day 30, twenty-four over Days 31–44 and two on Day 45. All twenty-eight were consumed; Zero has no personal stock.

people.title: Vegeta · Time Patroller
people.summary: Rescuer and assigned partner. Openly resents being paired with a weak human trainee.

facts.label: Current assignment
facts.value: Temporary lower-risk solo roster; partnership retained

people.details: Short, muscular, upright black hair and widow’s peak; retained brown tail, original white-and-gold Saiyan armour with extended shoulder and waist panels over a blue suit. Clipped commands, insults and imperious pride. He rescued Zero and later said his correction mission was complete without explaining it. Their partnership remains despite his temporary lower-risk solo roster. After Zero challenged him, he began punishing daily training at 50× gravity, providing senzu for severe injuries. Zero has not landed a hit on him. This does not establish a friendlier relationship. His exact age, numerical power and personal history remain unrevealed.

people.title: Krillin
people.summary: Time Patrol combat instructor and Zero’s first combat and ki teacher.

facts.label: Last seen
facts.value: Day 45 evening · Practice hall, with Zero

people.details: Short, compact and muscular, bald with six forehead dots, orange gi, blue wristbands and calloused hands. Lively conversation, wry humour and practical corrections. He introduced Yamcha, supervised sparring and taught the first projected blasts. He works as a combat instructor, rather than an active field Patroller. Having finished instruction for the day, he notices Zero’s bloodstained clothes and asks whether he received a senzu before inviting him in. He has not been told the new 174 reading. His exact age, numerical power and family circumstances remain unrevealed.

people.title: Mr. Satan · Hercule
people.summary: Dispatcher and routine supervisor of the “Temporal Super Stars.”

facts.label: Authority
facts.value: Scheduling, training logistics and restricted tasking

facts.label: Last seen
facts.value: Day 8 · Courtyard awning; current whereabouts unconfirmed

people.details: Stocky, thick black moustache and large curly hair; burgundy martial outfit, white cape, conspicuous gold belt and dispatch headset. Booming, gravelly showmanship and grand claims accompany practical arrangements for escort, training, housing and meals. He authorised Vegeta’s temporary lower-risk solo roster. His exact age and alternate history are unknown.

people.title: Chronoa
people.summary: Supreme Kai of Time; conducted the exceptional review of Zero’s arrival and knowledge.
people.details: Small, pink-skinned, pointed ears, swept orange hair, gold earrings and purple-and-gold clothing. Bright, brisk questions and direct authority. She confirmed Zero’s game-history account and offered supervised trainee membership. She is not his everyday dispatcher. No result explaining his origin has yet been reported. Exact age unknown.

people.title: Dr. Rill
people.summary: Time Patrol clinician who treated and medically cleared Zero.
people.details: Appears in her forties, brown skin, square face, close-cropped black hair grey at the temples, white medical jacket over teal clothing. Low, brisk voice and concrete clinical answers. Reported completed treatment and clear scans, heard Zero’s account, forwarded it to coordination and measured his power at 50. Last seen in the medical ward; present whereabouts unknown.

people.title: Nappa
people.summary: Attacked Zero outside Capsule Corp; overwhelmingly stronger.
people.details: Huge, bald, black moustache, white-and-gold Saiyan armour, bare muscular arms and brown tail. Deep, rough voice; amused cruelty gave way to anger at Zero’s insults. Zero’s punches, clawing and biting attempts did not visibly injure him. Vegeta knocked him unconscious; he was breathing when last seen. His later whereabouts are unknown to Zero. Exact age unknown.

people.title: Yamcha
people.summary: Experienced sparring partner introduced by Krillin; his reported power is 210.

facts.label: Reported power
facts.value: 210 · Reported by Krillin, not self-scanned by Zero

facts.label: Last seen
facts.value: Day 10 evening · Leaving the practice court

people.details: Appears in his late twenties; lean and broad-shouldered, long black hair, familiar cheek and forehead scars, faded orange gi, blue wraps and worn knuckles. Relaxed, slightly rough voice, easygoing conversation and dry humour. Controlled his strikes during the spar, recovered from a shoulder throw and countered Zero’s exhausted final kick. His exact age, home history and formal Patrol role remain unknown.

people.title: Bulma
people.summary: Technical-maintenance specialist at the training complex.
people.details: Appears in her thirties; jaw-length turquoise hair, blue work jacket with rolled sleeves, dark trousers and tool belt. Bright, brisk voice and dry sarcasm when rushed. Zero has noticed Vegeta frequently nearby, but their relationship is unknown. She warned him against switching on exposed machinery, demanded he release Zero and said he should train Zero. The training room she was repairing was out of service when last discussed; completion is unconfirmed.

places.title: Conton City
places.summary: Time Patrol hub where Zero was treated, assessed and housed.
places.details: Recognised from prior game knowledge and identified by Rill. Zero has visited the ward, reception, training facilities, quarters and dining hall. The city’s local calendar date has not been confirmed.

places.title: Training courtyard
places.summary: Open court used for sparring, weighted conditioning, ki practice and flight.
places.details: Used for later Krillin and Yamcha practice and Zero’s first rush at Vegeta on Day 30. Vegeta then led him into an adjoining equipped hall. The open court and enclosed gravity hall are distinct spaces.

places.title: Room 214
places.summary: Assigned quarters and overnight recovery space.
places.details: Single bed, desk, wardrobe, bathroom, clean towels, window, schedule terminal and a fridge with supplied cola. Zero slept here between training days; on Day 45 before dawn he confirmed 168 twice before leaving. The access card does not lift his escort restriction.

places.title: Dining hall
places.summary: Covered meals and communal seating for patrollers.
places.details: Visited after receiving room 214 and used for covered meals during training. After Day 44 Zero ate a large meal of meat and rice with additional helpings before returning to sleep. No cash purchase was recorded.

places.title: Medical ward
places.summary: Where Zero woke after emergency evacuation and treatment.
places.details: An empty glass treatment chamber stood opposite the bed. Rill reported that roughly an hour had passed since admission and that the latest scans were clear after treatment for internal bleeding, damaged ribs and a head injury. Original clothes and the scouter were kept nearby.

places.title: Reception · Room three
places.summary: Across the square from the ward; site of Chronoa’s assessment.
places.details: Zero recounted his source-world knowledge in front of Chronoa, Vegeta and Mr. Satan, then accepted supervised trainee membership.

places.title: Capsule Corp · West City
places.summary: Awakening site and the scene of Nappa’s attack.
places.details: Capsule Corp signage and buildings, damaged streets, fleeing people and dead civilians. No Capsule Corp affiliation, property or vehicle ownership follows from awakening there. The exact local chronology was not confirmed to Zero.

places.title: Training complex · Maintenance bay
places.summary: Adjoining work area where Bulma repairs training equipment.
places.details: Visited with Krillin on Day 29. Bulma worked beside an open equipment casing with a diagnostic tablet; Vegeta stood by a wall control panel. This was where Vegeta agreed to train Zero at dawn. No technical specifications or repaired-room access have been established.

places.title: Gravity training hall
places.summary: Enclosed hall used for Vegeta’s punishing training sessions.
places.details: Entered on Day 30; Zero set aside cape and scouter inside. Vegeta switched the hall to 50× gravity. Subsequent mornings include 25× warm-ups before his arrival and 50× sessions with senzu recoveries. Gravity is lowered when needed to prevent death and switched off when the session ends. This does not establish that the separate room Bulma was repairing is operational.

places.title: Practice hall
places.summary: Ordinary practice hall where Krillin has just finished teaching.
places.details: Reached after Day 45 training with Vegeta. Normal gravity; Krillin has noticed Zero’s bloodstained clothes and invited him in. No new exercise or spar has begun.

projects.title: Qualify for field duty
projects.summary: Daily gravity training has increased power and loaded movement; field clearance remains outstanding.
projects.details: Zero can stand, move deliberately and use short combinations at 50× gravity. Fast turns, bracing under impact, flight and moving blast accuracy still need work. No named technique, transformation, mission assignment or qualification deadline has been established.

projects.title: Vegeta partnership
projects.summary: Zero accepted the supervised trainee assignment.
projects.details: Vegeta was initially held from ordinary field assignments, then secured a temporary lower-risk solo roster with briefing compliance, active communications and escalation reporting. It ends when Zero qualifies for paired deployment. Since Day 30 he has trained Zero harshly each day; this does not cancel the waiver or imply a friendlier relationship. No particular future mission has been assigned.

projects.title: Origin assessment
projects.summary: Zero’s account and unusual arrival remain under investigation.
projects.details: Rill forwarded his report; Chronoa tested and confirmed his knowledge of past events. No explanation for the crossing or independent timeline clearance has been given.

events.title: Awakening in West City
events.summary: Zero wakes on his back, notices an athletic body and unfamiliar clothes, then stands outside Capsule Corp.
events.details: Nappa approaches from the damaged street and swings a backhand toward him.

events.title: A punch that changes nothing
events.summary: Zero ducks the casual swing and puts his weight behind a punch to Nappa’s jaw. It lands without harming him.
events.details: Nappa grabs his upper arm, knees his abdomen and throws him onto the paving. Zero remains conscious, hurt and struggling to breathe.

events.title: Anger against a Saiyan
events.summary: Surrounded by destruction and dead civilians, Zero insults Nappa and charges again.
events.details: Nappa strikes his face and ribs, drops him and moves to stomp him. A recognisable Vegeta interrupts and orders Nappa away. Anger did not close the power gap.

events.title: Vegeta intervenes
events.summary: Zero lunges at distracted Nappa with clawing and biting attempts; Nappa restrains him without visible injury.
events.details: Vegeta knocks Nappa unconscious with two strikes. Nappa is still breathing. Vegeta scans Zero with an unfamiliar instrument and asks what he is.

events.title: A name and a scouter
events.summary: Critically injured and vomiting blood, Zero takes Nappa’s scouter and whispers his name.
events.details: Vegeta speaks to an unseen contact about the readings, then calls for medical recovery. Zero is placed in an emergency transport cradle. The reply from the other end is inaudible.

events.title: Waking in Conton City
events.summary: Zero wakes in a Time Patrol medical ward, physically healed, and meets Dr. Rill.
events.details: She reports treatment and clear scans, including the repaired head injury. His clothes and scouter were kept. About an hour has passed since admission; no permanent physical deficit remains.

events.title: The Time Patrol
events.summary: Zero asks where he is and why. Rill explains the emergency extraction and identifies Vegeta as a Patroller.
events.details: She describes the Patrol’s work against interference with history and asks for his last memory before West City.

events.title: Fiction somewhere else
events.summary: Zero describes going to sleep and waking changed in West City, and says this world is fiction where he comes from.
events.details: Rill records his account as unverified and forwards it to coordination. Zero insists he must be dreaming.

events.title: The first reading · 50
events.summary: Zero confirms his clothing and body changed, activates the recovered scouter and experiments with its controls.
events.details: Rill assists by scanning him twice: 50. She returns the device. Recovery itself granted no power increase.

events.title: Cleared to leave the ward
events.summary: Zero asks whether he is free to go. Rill distinguishes medical discharge from the pending assessment.
events.details: An authorised escort is required beyond the ward. The automated reply confirms Mr. Satan has been notified.

events.title: The illustrious dispatcher
events.summary: Zero dresses in his original outfit. Mr. Satan arrives and introduces his “Temporal Super Stars.”
events.details: Assessment is in reception room three, across the square. Satan confirms clearance and offers to escort Zero.

events.title: An audience with Chronoa
events.summary: Zero follows Mr. Satan to the assessment room, where Chronoa and his rescuer Vegeta wait.
events.details: Chronoa has read Rill’s report. She asks what the game showed him about this place.

events.title: Knowledge of their past
events.summary: Zero recounts the first two Xenoverse main stories. Chronoa confirms that the account matches real past events.
events.details: The two stories had distinct hero Patrollers; the second happened about two hub years ago. She asks whether Zero can identify this particular Vegeta’s history.

events.title: The offer
events.summary: Zero summarises his broader Dragon Ball knowledge but acknowledges he cannot identify an unfamiliar alternate Vegeta.
events.details: Chronoa confirms the control question and offers supervised trainee membership, housing and instruction. Vegeta says his correction mission is complete, without explaining it, and fiercely objects to the proposed partnership.

events.title: A reluctant partner
events.summary: Zero accepts and honestly questions whether he would slow Vegeta down.
events.details: Chronoa records the acceptance and explains the supervision. Satan handles logistics. Vegeta’s ordinary field deployment is initially suspended until Zero is ready, provoking open resentment.

events.title: Meeting the instructor
events.summary: Zero follows Satan to the training hall; Vegeta accompanies them. Krillin takes the initial assessment.
events.details: Krillin has the medical clearance and power reading. A half-hour room slot is available; he asks Zero to set aside cape and scouter and show his stance.

events.title: Taking a stance
events.summary: Zero places the scouter on his removed cape and steps onto the mat, left arm and leg forward.
events.details: Krillin cues fist closure when striking and begins a guarded advance-and-retreat drill.

events.title: Finding the footwork
events.summary: Steady advance and retreat are manageable; abrupt reversals reveal hesitation and a long recovery step.
events.details: Smaller steps improve the slower repeat. Controlled sparring follows the footwork assessment.

events.title: Controlled sparring
events.summary: Krillin avoids or redirects the opening attacks, taps an exposed rib and trips Zero with a controlled palm strike.
events.details: Zero gets back into stance. Krillin advises tracking the body; Vegeta points out the shoulder wind-up. The exercise continues into the afternoon.

events.title: The first spark
events.summary: An afternoon of controlled sparring brings bruises and a minor split lip. Ki practice finally produces three tiny flashes.
events.details: Training moves to the courtyard after the room booking ends. Gathering remains unreliable and fatigue-sensitive. Satan arranges refreshments and reports the room is ready.

events.title: Room 214
events.summary: Zero retrieves cape and scouter, follows Satan to his room and receives the access card before visiting the dining hall.
events.details: Housing and meals are covered. The bedside terminal handles reception and schedules; the escort restriction remains. Krillin recommends rest instead of exhausted overnight practice.

events.title: One week later · 60
events.summary: A week of training, meals and rest yields basic deliberate ki control, low hovering and slow courtyard flight. Rested self-checks now read 60.
events.details: The old split lip heals; ordinary soreness and minor bruises remain. Vegeta gains temporary permission for lower-risk solo work until Zero is field-ready. The latest flight ends upright after a wide turn and stumbling landing. Krillin warns that airborne control still needs too much attention under threat. Satan gives Vegeta the assessment: still not cleared. Vegeta asks what is available tomorrow; no answer is recorded.

events.title: Seeking harder training
events.summary: Zero approaches Krillin after the flight assessment.
events.details: Krillin asks what is bothering him; no new mission is assigned.

events.title: A harder programme
events.summary: Zero asks to train harder and longer. Krillin agrees to increase the work.
events.details: Morning weighted conditioning and longer controlled sparring are arranged, beginning with low aerial pressure practice.

events.title: A new sparring partner · 64
events.summary: Two days of intensified practice bring two rested readings of 64. Krillin introduces Yamcha.
events.details: Krillin reports Yamcha’s full power as 210. Low-flight recovery through light contact improves, but solid body shots still break concentration.

events.title: The opening kick
events.summary: A ki-assisted rush carries Zero around Yamcha’s side, but the spinning kick is blocked.
events.details: Poor braking widens the pivot. Yamcha checks a counter into the ribs; Zero stays upright.

events.title: A feint and a sweep
events.summary: A palm-light feint draws Yamcha’s attention; the sweep catches an ankle and off-balances him.
events.details: Yamcha vaults clear, then advances with a shoulder shove. No actual ki blast was fired.

events.title: Using his momentum
events.summary: Zero catches the reaching wrist and completes a shoulder throw using Yamcha’s forward step.
events.details: Yamcha rolls through the landing without apparent injury, stands and approaches more cautiously with a jab.

events.title: Holding the guard
events.summary: Zero blocks the jab and a short controlled combination.
events.details: The impacts sting and move his guard, but he remains upright. Yamcha circles just outside range.

events.title: The final combination
events.summary: A long attack sequence forces Yamcha to give ground and glances his shoulder.
events.details: Fatigue spoils the final spinning kick. Yamcha interrupts with a controlled chest-palm shove; Zero falls, exhausted, and Krillin ends the round.

events.title: Back on his feet
events.summary: Zero struggles upright, loudly gasping for air.
events.details: Krillin keeps the round stopped and asks whether he is dizzy or just breathless. No serious injury is established.

events.title: Guard raised again
events.summary: Zero raises his guard despite exhaustion.
events.details: Yamcha declines another exchange. Krillin steps between them and keeps the round stopped.

events.title: A break in the spar
events.summary: Zero objects to being coddled. Krillin confirms the break.
events.details: Yamcha sits at the edge of the court. Zero remains standing in guard; no new round occurs.

events.title: Back to the weights
events.summary: Zero equips borrowed wrist and ankle weights and begins shadowboxing without resting.
events.details: Fatigue slows his punches and disrupts footwork. Krillin declines further sparring in that condition.

events.title: Five days of escalating weight
events.summary: The load rises from 5 to 80 kg per limb over five training days.
events.details: Slow technique and ki-light control improve at lighter loads; the final 320 kg total badly slows combinations. A Day 13 check reads 67. By Day 15 evening the exhausted reading is 58.

events.title: One more set
events.summary: Zero reports 58 to Krillin and tries another set.
events.details: Three short punches go out before the right arm stalls below guard. Krillin offers to remove the weights. No new injury occurs.

events.title: Rest and a reading · 68
events.summary: Krillin removes and returns the weights, then escorts Zero to room 214.
events.details: After a couple of hours’ sleep, Zero drinks cola and checks himself: 68. Acute exhaustion has eased, but soreness and tiredness remain.

events.title: Adapting to 320 kg
events.summary: Seven days at 80 kg per wrist and ankle improve short combinations, footing and deliberate ki control.
events.details: Two pre-training scans on Day 22 read 75. At the evening session’s end, Krillin requests an unweighted movement test.

events.title: The first ki blast
events.summary: Unweighted movement is freer, though fast aerial turns remain unstable. One small ki shot reaches the wall.
events.details: The yellow-white shot chips the surface a few metres away. Other attempts fail; reliable repetition has not yet been achieved.

events.title: Four hundred kilos · 84
events.summary: Another week at 100 kg per limb improves short combinations and low-kick recovery.
events.details: Small planted ki blasts become repeatable, with variable aim and poor moving release. Two Day 29 morning scans read 84. Zero remains off field duty.

events.title: Bulma’s maintenance bay
events.summary: Zero returns the weights and finds Vegeta with Bulma, accompanied by Krillin.
events.details: Bulma is repairing equipment and says the training room is out of service. Her home history and relationship with this Vegeta are unknown.

events.title: An agreement at dawn
events.summary: Zero challenges Vegeta to train him. Vegeta grabs and releases his clothing, then agrees.
events.details: Krillin and Bulma intervene. Zero is uninjured. Vegeta specifies dawn outside the training hall, without weights.

events.title: Other versions of the prince
events.summary: Zero invokes Vegeta’s father, Frieza and admiration for another version of him.
events.details: Vegeta rejects the assumed understanding and comparisons, maintains the dawn appointment and leaves. No alternate biography is confirmed.

events.title: Returning to room 214
events.summary: Zero explains his provocation. Bulma agrees Vegeta should train him but objects to the father reference.
events.details: Krillin escorts Zero back to his room and suggests sleep. Bulma’s history and relationship remain unconfirmed.

events.title: Training with Vegeta · 85
events.summary: After overnight rest, Zero arrives two hours early, warms up lightly and scans himself twice: 85.
events.details: Vegeta arrives at dawn, tells him to remove the scouter and invites him to attack. The device is still worn and the first move is pending.

events.title: First rush at Vegeta
events.summary: Zero’s flurry is avoided or deflected. Vegeta catches his wrist and shoves him back, leaving temporary soreness but no serious injury.
events.details: Vegeta opens an adjoining hall. Zero is still outside with the scouter on; no gravity setting has been activated.

events.title: Fifty times gravity
events.summary: Zero follows Vegeta inside, lays the cape and scouter aside and takes a stance. The hall switches to 50× gravity, driving him down.
events.details: Vegeta lifts him, punches his abdomen and drops him. Zero remains conscious and breathing, in severe pain. No healing or power reading occurs.

events.title: Trying to rise
events.summary: Zero struggles toward hands and knees but cannot stand under 50× gravity. Vegeta kicks him in the ribs and knocks him down.
events.details: His cheek bleeds and breathing is painful and shallow. He remains conscious. No diagnosis, senzu or power gain is established by this exchange.

events.title: The first day ends
events.summary: The brutal session continues with two senzu recoveries. Zero manages a partial crouch and two dragging steps at 50× gravity.
events.details: Gravity is lowered during the session to prevent death, then restored. Vegeta ends the day and switches it off. After final healing, two self-scans read 89. Cape and scouter are collected; training resumes tomorrow. No hit lands on Vegeta.

events.title: Two weeks under pressure
events.summary: Daily 25× warm-ups and 50× sessions improve Zero’s loaded movement. Large meals and sleep fill the time between training.
events.details: Restored readings reach 124 on Day 37 and 168 twice at the end of Day 44. Twenty-four senzu are consumed over the fortnight. Zero can now stand, take measured steps and use short combinations at 50×, but quick movement and impacts still disrupt his support. No field clearance or successful strike on Vegeta.

events.title: A rested check
events.summary: After a large dinner and a night in room 214, Zero puts on the scouter and checks himself twice: 168.
events.details: The reading confirms the capacity already measured after Day 44 healing. Sleep has not created another separate power gain; departure for training follows.

events.title: Back to Krillin
events.summary: Another day of 25× preparation and 50× training ends with two senzu recoveries. Fully healed, Zero measures 174 twice and goes to find Krillin.
events.details: Scouter worn, cape collected and clothes bloodstained, Zero reaches an ordinary practice hall as Krillin finishes teaching. Krillin asks whether he received a senzu, then welcomes him in: “I’m finished here. What’s up?” Zero has not answered.
